36344-the-mentor-the-weather-serial-numb.creator: Charles Fitzhugh Talman
36344-the-mentor-the-weather-serial-numb.description: A book by Charles Fitzhugh Talman. , genial prophet and lover of his fellow men, is passing away, for the officer who organized the Weather Bureau became in time displeased with the name and changed the form of the daily prediction so as to read, "The indications are." The phrase is formal and severe. There is naught but cold comfort in it.

arxiv-2104-12947.title: Incorporating baseline covariates to validate surrogate endpoints with a constant biomarker under control arm
arxiv-2104-12947.creator: Emily Roberts, Michael Elliott, Jeremy M. G. Taylor
arxiv-2104-12947.description: Abstract Abstract A surrogate endpoint S in a clinical trial is an outcome that may be measured earlier or more easily than the true outcome of interest T . In this work, we extend causal inference approaches to validate such a surrogate using potential outcomes.

arxiv-2109-13219.title: Revisiting Inclusive Decay Widths of Charmed Mesons
arxiv-2109-13219.creator: Daniel King, Alexander Lenz, Maria Laura Piscopo, Thomas Rauh, Aleksey V. Rusov, Christos Vlahos

arxiv-2110-14191.title: Mixed Supervised Object Detection by Transferring Mask Prior and Semantic Similarity
arxiv-2110-14191.creator: Yan Liu, Zhijie Zhang, Li Niu, Junjie Chen, Liqing Zhang
arxiv-2110-14191.description: Abstract Object detection has achieved promising success, but requires large-scale fully-annotated data, which is time-consuming and labor-extensive. Therefore, we consider object detection with mixed supervision, which learns novel object categories using weak annotations with the help of full annotations of existing base object categories.

arxiv-2202-00435.title: A STUDY ON CONVOLUTION NEURAL NETWORK FOR RECONSTRUCTING THE TEMPERATURE FIELD OF WALL-BOUNDED FLOWS
arxiv-2202-00435.creator: Victor Coppo Leite, Elia Merzari, Roberto Ponciroli, Lander Ibarra
arxiv-2202-00435.description: Abstract In the present study, the capabilities of a new Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model are explored with the paramount objective of reconstructing the temperature field of wall-bounded flows based on a limited set of measurement points taken at the boundaries of the fluid domain.

arxiv-2204-11673.title: Incorporating Explicit Knowledge in Pre-trained Language Models for Passage Re-ranking Conference: Proceedings of the 45th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 11–15, 2022; Madrid, Spain Proceedings of the 45th International ACM SIGIR Conferen
arxiv-2204-11673.creator: Qian Dong 1,3† , Yiding Liu 2 , Suqi Cheng 2 , Shuaiqiang Wang 2 , Zhicong Cheng 2 , Shuzi Niu 3∗ , and Dawei Yin 2∗
arxiv-2204-11673.description: Abstract . Passage re-ranking is to obtain a permutation over the candidate passage set from retrieval stage. Re-rankers have been boomed by Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) due to their overwhelming advantages in natural language understanding. However, existing PLM based re-rankers may easily suffer from vocabulary mismatch and lack of domain specific knowledge.

arxiv-2208-02527.title: Weighted non-autonomous 𝐋 𝒒 ​ ( 𝐋 𝒑 ) \bm{\mathrm{L}^{q}(\mathrm{L}^{p})} maximal regularity for complex systems under mixed regularity in space and time
arxiv-2208-02527.creator: Sebastian Bechtel
arxiv-2208-02527.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sebastian Bechtel. We show weighted non-autonomous L q ​ ( L p ) \mathrm{L}^{q}(\mathrm{L}^{p}) maximal regularity for families of complex second-order systems in divergence form under a mixed regularity condition in space and time.

arxiv-2208-06109.title: Simultaneous Trapping of Two Optical Pulses in an Atomic Ensemble as Stationary Light Pulses
arxiv-2208-06109.creator: U-Shin Kim, Yoon-Ho Kim
arxiv-2208-06109.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by U-Shin Kim, Yoon-Ho Kim. The stationary light pulse (SLP) refers to a zero-group-velocity optical pulse in an atomic ensemble prepared by two counter-propagating driving fields. Despite the uniqueness of an optical pulse trapped within an atomic medium without a cavity, observations of SLP so far have been limited to trapping a single optical pulse due to the stringent SLP phase-matching condition, and this has severely hindered the development of SLP-based applications.

arxiv-2304-00744.title: Joint Device Activity Detection, Channel Estimation and Signal Detection for Massive Grant-free Access via BiGAMP
arxiv-2304-00744.creator: Shanshan Zhang, Ying Cui, Wen Chen
arxiv-2304-00744.description: Abstract Massive access has been challenging for the fifth generation (5G) and beyond since the abundance of devices causes communication overload to skyrocket. In an uplink massive access scenario, device traffic is sporadic in any given coherence time. Thus, channels across the antennas of each device exhibit correlation, which can be characterized by the row sparse channel matrix structure.

arxiv-2407-21770.title: MoMa: Efficient Early-Fusion Pre-training with Mixture of Modality-Aware Experts
arxiv-2407-21770.creator: Xi Victoria Lin, Akshat Shrivastava, Liang Luo, Srinivasan Iyer, Mike Lewis, Gargi Ghosh, Luke Zettlemoyer, Armen Aghajanyan
arxiv-2407-21770.description: Abstract We introduce MoMa, a novel modality-aware mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture designed for pre-training mixed-modal, early-fusion language models. MoMa processes images and text in arbitrary sequences by dividing expert modules into modality-specific groups. These groups exclusively process designated tokens while employing learned routing within each group to maintain semantically informed adaptivity.

pmc-10527695.title: Sensory-Guided Isolation, Identification, and Active Site Calculation of Novel Umami Peptides from Ethanol Precipitation Fractions of Fermented Grain Wine (Huangjiu)
pmc-10527695.creator: Rui Chang, Zhilei Zhou, Yong Dong, Yuezheng Xu, Zhongwei Ji, Shuangping Liu, Jian Mao
pmc-10527695.description: Huangjiu is rich in low-molecular-weight peptides and has an umami taste. In order for its umami peptides to be discovered, huangjiu was subjected to ultrafiltration, ethanol precipitation, and macroporous resin purification processes. The target fractions were gathered according to sensory evaluation. Subsequently, we used peptidomics to identify the sum of 4158 peptides in most umami fractions.

pmc-10622873.title: Achieving atomically ordered GaN/AlN quantum heterostructures: The role of surface polarity
pmc-10622873.creator: Yuanpeng Wu, Peng Zhou, Yixin Xiao, Kai Sun, Ding Wang, Ping Wang, Zetian Mi
pmc-10622873.description: SignificanceA strong dependence of interfacial diffusion on surface polarity is observed in GaN/AlN quantum heterostructures. GaN/AlN quantum heterostructures with near-perfect quantum interface are achieved on the semipolar plane. Theoretical calculations show that the atomic substitution process is significantly suppressed on the semipolar plane compared with the conventional c-plane.

pmc-10702722.title: An improved hybrid whale optimization algorithm for global optimization and engineering design problems
pmc-10702722.creator: Abolfazl Rahimnejad, Ebrahim Akbari, Seyedali Mirjalili, Stephen Andrew Gadsden, Pavel Trojovský, Eva Trojovská
pmc-10702722.description: The whale optimization algorithm (WOA) is a widely used metaheuristic optimization approach with applications in various scientific and industrial domains. However, WOA has a limitation of relying solely on the best solution to guide the population in subsequent iterations, overlooking the valuable information embedded in other candidate solutions.

pmc-11310207.title: Structural basis of divergent substrate recognition and inhibition of human neurolysin
pmc-11310207.creator: Ke Shi, Sounak Bagchi, Jordis Bickel, Shiva H Esfahani, Lulu Yin, Tiffany Cheng, Vardan T Karamyan, Hideki Aihara
pmc-11310207.description: A zinc metallopeptidase neurolysin (Nln) processes diverse bioactive peptides to regulate signaling in the mammalian nervous system. To understand how Nln interacts with various peptides with dissimilar sequences, we determined crystal structures of Nln in complex with diverse peptides including dynorphins, angiotensin, neurotensin, and bradykinin.

pmc-11351147.title: NK Cells in the Lymph Nodes and Their Role in Anti-Tumour Immunity
pmc-11351147.creator: Lara V Graham, Salim I Khakoo, Matthew D Blunt, Vincent Vieillard
pmc-11351147.description: The lymph nodes are vital to enable adaptive immune responses to infection. Natural killer (NK) cells are cytotoxic lymphocytes that directly kill cancer cells and modulate the activation of other immune cells during anti-tumour immune response. NK cells in the lymph nodes are involved in the regulation of T-cell and B-cell populations and the clearance of viral infections.

pmc-11355918.title: Inhibition of Soluble Epoxide Hydrolase by Cembranoid Diterpenes from Soft Coral Sinularia maxima: Enzyme Kinetics, Molecular Docking, and Molecular Dynamics
pmc-11355918.creator: Nguyen Viet Phong, Nguyen Phuong Thao, Le Ba Vinh, Bui Thi Thuy Luyen, Chau Van Minh, Seo Young Yang, Rosa Maria Vitale, Ines Mancini, Andrea Defant
pmc-11355918.description: Soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH) is essential for converting epoxy fatty acids, such as epoxyeicosatrienoic acids (EETs), into their dihydroxy forms. EETs play a crucial role in regulating blood pressure, mediating anti-inflammatory responses, and modulating pain, making sEH a key target for therapeutic interventions.

pmc-11452419.title: Evaluating the predictive effect of vitamin D on clinical outcomes of infliximab-treated Crohn’s disease patients in western China
pmc-11452419.creator: Xiaomei Song, Huihui Zhang, Junya Song, Hao Wang, Hong Guo, Xiaoqin Zhou
pmc-11452419.description: The aim was to evaluate predictors of clinical outcomes in infliximab (IFX)-treated Crohn’s disease (CD) patients in western China and provide evidence for future treatment optimization. Our retrospective study included CD patients at Chongqing General Hospital from July 2022 to July 2023. Clinical data of CD patients at baseline and the endpoint (the seventh IFX treatment, 38 weeks) were collected.

pmc-11574337.title: The genome sequence of a hoverfly, Cheilosia grossa (Fallén, 1817)
pmc-11574337.creator: Ryan Mitchell, Steven Falk, Katie J. Woodcock, Natural History Museum Genome Acquisition Lab, University of Oxford and Wytham Woods Genome Acquisition Lab, Darwin Tree of Life Barcoding collective, Wellcome Sanger Institute Tree of Life Management, Samples and Laboratory team, Wellcome Sanger Instit
pmc-11574337.description: We present a genome assembly from an individual male Cheilosia grossa (a hoverfly; Arthropoda; Insecta; Diptera; Syrphidae). The genome sequence has a total length of 362.40 megabases. Most of the assembly is scaffolded into 6 chromosomal pseudomolecules, including the X sex chromosome. The mitochondrial genome has also been assembled and is 17.81 kilobases in length.

pmc-11652044.title: Potential for contrast-enhanced intraoperative ultrasonography with the Kupffer phase to improve and guide therapeutic strategies for hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-11652044.creator: Chen Li, Yuan Liu, Mingxiao Wu, Junmin Wei, Jinghai Song
pmc-11652044.description: BackgroundNot all malignant tumors, especially in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients with cirrhosis, can be detected by preoperative imaging methods. Therefore, it is urgently necessary to improve the intraoperative detectability of HCCs. Contrast-enhanced intraoperative ultrasonography (CE-IOUS) is an effective technique for detecting and characterizing occulting HCC lesions.

pmc-13040858.title: Workplace spirituality as a predictor of nursing self-efficacy and job embeddedness
pmc-13040858.creator: Maysa Fekry Ahmed, Eman Sameh AbdElhay, Asmaa Moustafa Abd-ElGhani
pmc-13040858.description: IntroductionEgypt’s healthcare system faces significant challenges for the nursing workforce, including high turnover rates and job dissatisfaction. Understanding the factors that enhance nurse retention and self-efficacy is crucial for improving healthcare delivery in the Egyptian context, where workplace spirituality may play a significant role, given cultural and religious values.

pmc-13244074.title: Quantitative Disk and Metabolic Bone PET‐MRI for Understanding Disk‐Endplate Crosstalk in Degeneration of the Lumbar Spine
pmc-13244074.creator: Virginie Kreutzinger, Katharina Ziegeler, Misung Han, Cynthia T. Chin, Rupsa Bhattacharjee, Isabelle Remick, Emma Bahroos, Sharmila Majumdar
pmc-13244074.description: ObjectivesThe aim of this investigation was to explore the association between disk degeneration, quantified by Pfirrmann grades and T1rho as a marker of hydration, and bone remodeling in the vertebral endplate quantified by Na[18F]F uptake on PET.MethodsSubjects for this exploratory, post hoc analysis were selected from a prospective observational study on low back pain.

pmc-13432891.title: Is targeted biopsy necessary for Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System 3 lesions?
pmc-13432891.creator: Diğdem Kuru Öz, Sezer Nil Yılmazer Zorlu, Nuray Haliloğlu, Ayşe Erden
pmc-13432891.description: SUMMARYOBJECTIVE:The aim of this study was to reveal the histopathological results of Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System 3 lesions and to investigate whether targeted biopsy is essential in these lesions.METHODS:One hundred and twenty-seven patients with 176 lesions, being categorized as Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System 3 according to Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System version 2.
